description: This Kotlin source file defines a fake implementation of the TopicsRepository interface, providing in-memory or mock data for testing purposes. It retrieves topic data from a demo network data source and exposes methods to get all topics and a specific topic by ID. The repository is intended for use in testing or development environments to simulate data fetching

classes.name: FakeTopicsRepository
classes.description: A fake implementation of the TopicsRepository interface that returns mock topic data for testing purposes.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns a flow that emits a list of Topic objects obtained from the demo network data source.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns a flow that emits a single Topic object matching the specified ID, obtained from the list of all topics.

methods.name: syncWith
methods.description: A suspending function that simulates synchronization; always returns true.
